svg.title: The $425,000 Base-Case Profit Bridge
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-bridge; chart type: waterfall; title: The $425,000 Base-Case Profit Bridge; subtitle: Four cost deductions reconcile to $180,625 owner net profit.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Annual USD. Opening and closing bars are absolute totals; intermediate bars are signed deductions. The cost allocation is illustrative, while revenue, profit, and margin are canonical. This example assumes the operator controls sublicensed rights and recognizes the associated fees gross; agency pass-through receipts are excluded. Recurring personnel and administration total $10,000 monthly; rights participation and transaction-specific legal and audit expenses are additional variable costs.; caption: $425,000 - $96,000 - $24,000 - $85,000 - $39,375 = $180,625. Total modeled costs are $244,375; $180,625 / $425,000 = 42.5%.; stages: label: Recognized license revenue; value: $425,000 annual operator fees and royalties; numeric value: 425000.0; detail: Opening total includes recognized license fees and royalties only, never the licensees' product-sales base.; label: Personnel and delivery; value: Deduct $96,000 for recurring pod work; numeric value: -96000.0; detail: Illustrative annual allowance for operator delivery and recurring contractor retainers; exclude distributions of the closing owner profit.; label: Systems and administration; value: Deduct $24,000 for recurring operating infrastructure; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Fund reporting tools, insurance, bookkeeping, secure document storage, and administration without duplicating personnel costs.; label: Rights-holder participation; value: Deduct $85,000 in contractual rights payments; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Illustrative 20% participation on recognized revenue under controlled sublicensing arrangements; replace this allocation when the actual rights structure differs.; label: Deal-specific legal and audits; value: Deduct $39,375 for variable specialist services; numeric value: -39375.0; detail: Expense transaction-specific drafting, rights investigation, and royalty examinations separately from recurring retainers; this bar is not an unspent cash reserve.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $180,625 retained at 42.5% modeled margin; numeric value: 180625.0; detail: Closing total equals revenue less all four modeled cost categories and matches the canonical Base-Case result.

circle.title: label: Recognized license revenue; value: $425,000 annual operator fees and royalties; numeric value: 425000.0; detail: Opening total includes recognized license fees and royalties only, never the licensees' product-sales base.

label: Personnel and delivery; value: Deduct $96,000 for recurring pod work; numeric value: -96000.0; detail: Illustrative annual allowance for operator delivery and recurring contractor retainers; exclude distributions of the closing owner profit.

label: Systems and administration; value: Deduct $24,000 for recurring operating infrastructure; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Fund reporting tools, insurance, bookkeeping, secure document storage, and administration without duplicating personnel costs.

label: Rights-holder participation; value: Deduct $85,000 in contractual rights payments; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Illustrative 20% participation on recognized revenue under controlled sublicensing arrangements; replace this allocation when the actual rights structure differs.

label: Deal-specific legal and audits; value: Deduct $39,375 for variable specialist services; numeric value: -39375.0; detail: Expense transaction-specific drafting, rights investigation, and royalty examinations separately from recurring retainers; this bar is not an unspent cash reserve.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $180,625 retained at 42.5% modeled margin; numeric value: 180625.0; detail: Closing total equals revenue less all four modeled cost categories and matches the canonical Base-Case result.

text.title: Assumptions: Annual USD. Opening and closing bars are absolute totals; intermediate bars are signed deductions. The cost allocation is illustrative, while revenue, profit, and margin are canonical. This example assumes the operator controls sublicensed rights and recognizes the associated fees gross; agency pass-through receipts are excluded. Recurring personnel and administration total $10,000 monthly; rights participation and transaction-specific legal and audit expenses are additional variable costs.
